sloka: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण स हि प्राप्तो वनालयः ।सहस्रांशुसुतो धीमान् सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ।। ५.६२.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: nimeṣāntaramātreṇa sa hi prāpto vanālayaḥ ।sahasrāṁśusuto dhīmān sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ ।। 5.62.37 ।।।।

translations.english: In a moment, Dadhimukha reached the place where wise Sugriva, the son of Sungod was there
